tasks.title: Create src/datautils package structure
tasks.description: Set up the directory and files for the datautils library under the src/datautils folder. This includes creating an __init__.py to mark it as a Python package.

tasks.title: Add tests under tests/
tasks.description: Create a tests directory and add initial test files that will be used to verify the functionality of the datautils library. The tests should cover basic use cases and edge cases.

tasks.title: Write pyproject metadata
tasks.description: Create a pyproject.toml file with necessary metadata such as the project name, version, description, authors, and dependencies. This file is essential for building and packaging the library.

tasks.title: Write README
tasks.description: Compose a README.md file that describes what the datautils library does, how to install it, and how to use it. Include examples and any other relevant information for users and contributors.

summary: This plan outlines the steps to bootstrap a Python library named 'datautils'. It involves setting up the package structure, adding a testing framework, defining the project's metadata, and documenting the project with a README. These tasks are prioritized to ensure that the core structure and documentation are in place before proceeding with further development.
